summary.tldr: Amends the Canada Labour Code so airport authorities and airport service providers must keep the previous union status and job terms when they replace a contractor.
what_it_does: Clarifies that section 44 of the Canada Labour Code applies to employers that are airport authorities or service providers to an airport authority.
Requires a new contractor that takes over from a previous contractor at an airport authority to respect the previous trade union certification.
Requires the new contractor to keep the former employees’ terms and conditions of employment, rights, and privileges.
Applies these rules when the replacement happens under a contract or other arrangement with an airport authority or its service provider.
summary.background: The bill changes the Canada Labour Code. It adds rules for employers linked to airports when they replace a previous contractor.
